parent_objective: implement controller-profile scaffolding for L0 L1 L2 L3 comparison without training
blocked_by: controller comparison design needs executable profile metadata before configs or training can be generated fairly
supersedes: manual ad hoc L0 L1 L2 L3 config construction
invalidates: starting controller training before profile instantiation and contract checks exist

public_gates: M1188 may implement profile metadata and instantiation tests only
M1188 must not train controller weights
M1188 must not run candidate replay
M1188 must not use private holdout
M1188 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train L0 L1 L2 or L3
do not change the deployable actor input contract
do not add slip tire force friction margin or hidden dynamics actor inputs
do not claim controller performance from scaffold tests

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds profile metadata masking and instantiation checks needed before fair L0 L1 L2 L3 training or evaluation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation adds hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if profile tests instantiate training or PPO
stop if L0 masking cannot be represented cleanly
stop if finite-window configs cannot be generated without actor-contract ambiguity
fallback_plan: if masking requires wrapper support, implement wrapper tests before config generation
if finite-window observation dimensions expose model-load incompatibility, route to config-only smoke before training
if temporal_gru profile support is missing, route to focused ActorCritic scaffold tests
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1187 design requires executable profile scaffold before dataset or training milestones

admission_evidence: M1187 defines fair controller levels and implementation gaps
Stack A process policy permits scaffold implementation
training remains blocked until profiles can be instantiated and contract-checked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: L2 finite-window profile metadata exists for 13 25 50 100 steps
L3 online GRU and reset-control profile metadata exists

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1188 is infrastructure. It must preserve L0 and L1 profiles so later experiments can test current-frame substitution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1188 should encode finite-window step counts but does not evaluate them.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If profile support exposes missing implementation paths, route to focused scaffold repair rather than training only L3.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A small profile scaffold can instantiate and contract-check L0 L1 L2 and L3 controller configurations without training or changing actor inputs.
success_criteria: L2 finite-window profiles for 13 25 50 and 100 steps are specified
L3 online GRU and reset-control metadata are specified
no hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input contract change occurs
failure_criteria: profile scaffold adds hidden or oracle actor input
profile tests start training or PPO
actor-input contract changes without explicit manifest

commands.name: implement_controller_profiles
commands.command: implement profile metadata and focused tests without training

decision_rule: M1188 passes if profile scaffolding and focused tests establish contract-clean L0/L1/L2/L3 metadata without training.
